Hi BioGeoBEARS users,

Today is the early registration deadline for IBS2015, also I believe there is still room in the BioGeoBEARS workshop, for those who want to learn about new models, stochastic mapping, etc.!

BioGeoBEARS workshop: January 8, 2015, International Biogeography Society Meeting, Bayreuth, Germany
http://phylo.wikidot.com/biogeobears-workshops#ibs2015

Cheers!
Nick

---------- Forwarded message ----------
From: Karen Faller <eve...@regonline.com>
Date: Tue, Sep 30, 2014 at 12:32 AM
Subject: IBS Early registration/Student Travel Awards Deadlines are TODAY
To: mat...@berkeley.edu


Dear Biogeographers

Another quick note to remind you that the Early registration rate, as well as the Student Travel Awards Deadlines are TODAY (September 30th).  If you're planning on coming and haven't already registered, register now to take advantage of the lower rates at https://www.bayceer.uni-bayreuth.de/ibs2015/.

If you've registered already and want to help others attend - it's not too late to help students (& post-docs from developing countries) by donating to the Student Travel Awards.  You can do so as an add-on via your meeting registration (internal section).  This is also the place where you would add on workshops and fieldtrips. 

Not coming to the conference but want to help others attend?  Donations can also be made via the 'donate now' button at http://www.biogeography.org/

If you're on the fence about coming - you should come!  Sure, Germany in January can be chilly, but we'll be having the welcome in the Botanical Gardens, the conference dinner in the Steam Train Museum, field trips to forest springs, medieval castles and breweries!  It's going to be a fun time, full of great science, and a great place to make connections or catch up with old friends. 

Hope to see you there!

Karen Faller
IBS Membership Services
